messages:
eng-oncall-bot: Pager triggered: P1
eli: on it. seeing two nodes flicker: infer-node-usw-12 and infer-node-usw-13.
marta: Customer impact: elevated tail latency and intermittent 503s for hosted-usw. Not full outage but degraded.
eli: `kubectl get nodes | grep infer-node-usw` -> nodes alternating NotReady/Ready. grabbing pod statuses.
eli: `kubectl get pods -n infra -o wide | grep infer-srv` -> multiple CrashLoopBackOffs on node 12.
sam: runtime logs from infer-srv-12 show repeated CUDA OOMs and oom-killer traces.

sam: logs:
```
E Mar 17 15:07:42 kernel: Out of memory: GPU 0 allocation failed
E Mar 17 15:07:42 runtime: fatal error: alloc failed in kv cache grow
stack trace ...
```

sam: looks like KV cache on long sessions spiked memory usage leading to driver OOM.
eli: cordon infer-node-usw-12 and 13. drain non-critical pods only, leave inference pods to finish.
eli: `kubectl cordon infer-node-usw-12` -> done.
marta: initiating routing fallback: prefer-region=usw-b then eu-west burst pool. Applying route override for 20m.
cassie: support queue shows 4 tickets tied to higher latency. notifying affected customers and adding status note.
sam: capture `nvidia-smi -q` and dmesg from node 12, uploading to /artifacts/incident/6798881234/
eng-oncall-bot: artifact uploaded: /artifacts/incident/6798881234/nvidia-smi.txt
sam: `nvidia-smi` shows GPU memory 98% used before crash on node 12.
sam: pushing temporary runtime guard: kv_cache_max=200 for model-family-y on hosted pools, will redeploy new pods.
eli: draining node 13 now, scaling up dedicated capacity in eu-west to take warm traffic.
marta: autoscale bumped +3, spinning warm pods in usw-b and eu-west.
eli: restarted kubelet on node 12: `ssh ops@infer-node-usw-12 sudo systemctl restart kubelet` -> node transitions NotReady -> Ready in ~18s.
marta: routing fallback reduced 503s from 7% -> 1.5%. token latency 95th still slightly high.
cassie: customer A ack'd status update; they requested ETA on RCA, provided ~48h.
sam: after kv limit and redeploy, new pods stable for 15m with no OOM observed.
eli: keeping nodes cordoned for 30m observation, then will uncordon if stable.
marta: action items: (1) RCA for kv cache leak and model-side session retention. (2) add GPU free memory alerts (threshold <12%). (3) add automatic kv guard when GPU mem >90%.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-679888 created and linked. Postmortem owner: sam. Severity: P1. Retro scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
eli: handing off to night oncall in 25m. any other blockers?
cassie: posting status to #support and emailing customers. :white_check_mark:
sam: will reproduce locally and review model changes in last 72h.
marta: notes saved to incident doc: suspected kv cache runaway -> mitigated by kv limit + routing fallback + kubelet restart.
eli: thanks team. monitoring for 45m then uncordon. :thumbsup:
